note: One event: explains the single keyframe snap of this window (ubaid-period_-4300, 87 cells in the Sulaymaniyah circle that the Ubaid took from the Samarra culture in -4800 and its -4300 loss events did not release).

region.text: the Rania plain of Tell Shemshara, the Sulaymaniyah circle outside the southern alluvium, that the Ubaid took over from the Samarra culture in 4800 BCE

events.note: 4300 BCE: the Sulaymaniyah circle outside the southern alluvium (Samarra culture's successor land, Ubaid since 4800 BCE) leaves the Ubaid with the rest of the north. "In Northern Mesopotamia the period runs only from about 5300 to 4300 BC" and is "succeeded by the Late Chalcolithic period". The dossier's own 4300 loss events release the Jazira, Assyria, the Amuq and the Samarra circle but not this one, so the keyframe ubaid-period_-4300 (Babylonia, Susiana, Gulf coast only) had to snap 87 cells away.
